drj-io/SlowOps.Scratchivision.description: Scratchivision is an MPC plugin (MPC OS 3.10.1+, built for the MPC XL) that turns a turntable with Serato-style control vinyl into a scratch controller for a sample. It is an insert effect: timecode audio goes into the track, the scratched sample comes out.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-drum-map.description: Drum Map: a topographic drum sequencer that plays a drum track from MPC's clock, from Émilie Gillet's open-source Grids. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-dual-slope.description: Dual Slope: two rise-and-fall generators (envelopes, LFOs, slew) that modulate other tracks, based on Befaco's Rampage VCV Rack module. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-eucalypso.description: Four-lane Euclidean sequencer: turns held notes into interlocking rhythms for other tracks. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-groovebank.description: Retriggers the chord you hold in a rhythm from a library of genre grooves. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-midiplayer.description: Plays Standard MIDI Files in time with MPC's transport. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-pixelwalkers.description: Generative: the notes you play become walkers that bounce and retrigger when they land. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-stevequencer.description: 16 steps on a 4x4 grid, up to four pages (64 steps), edited from the Q-Links. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-stevequencer16.description: 16 steps on a 4x4 grid and eight modulation lanes that can move any parameter of the instrument, on any page. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-superarp.description: A pattern and rhythm arpeggiator with 40 patterns, 40 rhythms and random modifiers. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

SamplingHigh/mpc-vst-setbfree.description: setBfree tonewheel organ port for Akai MPC OS and Force

gmorb/mpc-vst-sfizz.description: sfizz 1.2.3 SFZ sampler for MPC OS standalone hardware (Gen1 armv7 + Gen2 aarch64), with a one-page screen modelled on sfizz's editor

3dthc/Shapey-MPC.description: An 8-band parametric EQ you shape by touch, with a live analyzer.

3dthc/Sonix.description: Sonix is a ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, featuring a diverse collection of sounds including pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, basses, leads, and synths. Built with redistributable sound libraries, it brings a versatile range of melodic sounds to your MPC.

elizmita/davis-spectral-sidechain.description: One-band sidechain dynamic EQ for Akai MPC standalone (VST2, MPC OS 3.x). Put SEND on any source (kick, snare, vocal...) and RECEIVE on any track (bass, pads, samples...): it makes room only at the chosen frequency and only while the source plays. SC peak finder, live curve, output spectrum, 32-bit float audio.

sunskiefer/SQ8LMPC.description: Port of SQ8L 0.91b (Ensoniq SQ-80 emulation by Siegfried Kullmann) to Akai Force / MPC OS, ARMv7 VST2. Based on sq8l-revival. Unofficial, free, non-commercial.

djokenzi/steprunner-8.description: 8-track, 64-step sequencer plugin for Akai MPC standalone

jacob-sabella/mpc-vst-stompbox.description: A whole guitar rig (guitarix and GxPlugins, 219 models, 40 factory presets) as one VST insert effect for Akai MPC OS standalone devices, with a native screen skin

stampman3000-jpg/mpc-stream.description: Stream is a multichannel USB audio effect send. It needs BlackHole 64ch and a Mac helper app.

lightlikemusic/studio424.description: STUDIO424: an early-90s cassette four-track mixer channel in a pedal. Trim into a saturating preamp, two-band shelving EQ, channel fader and a driveable mix bus with master fader.

sd88me/mpc-vst-sturm.description: A six-voice analog-style drum and synth voice inspired by DSI Tempest for Akai MPC OS standalone devices. Uses the factory ROM for sounds and presets.

Devko/SubWerk.description: Analog-style monosynth VST for MPC OS on the Akai Force: morphing oscillators, a nonlinear transistor ladder, feedback, Multidrive, Duo, 57 presets, touchscreen pages

Luminous-Works/mpc-vst-sunflower.description: Sunflower: a Fibonacci sequencer for the Akai MPC. Two arms play a sunflower lattice at the golden angle; self-sounding, 14 modes, live playhead. Free, MIT. (Lumina Aerospace)

sunskiefer/SurgeXXL.description: Surge ported to MPC os full open source. Slight change to the code to be able to run on the mpc system. All the effects. Load surge patches and wavetables including your ones. Full wave table synth on MPC os.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-aphex.description: Korg MS-10/MS-20 style mono synth with a patch bay, an ESP section and both MS filters. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-chordism.description: One key in, a four-voice chord out: morphing oscillators, FM, filter, lo-fi, delay, reverb and an arpeggiator. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-denis.description: West Coast / Serge-inspired mono synth: complex oscillators, a wavefolder and a modulation matrix. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-fizzik.description: Physical modelling: an exciter and two coupled resonators (string, beam, plate, membrane). A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-hank.description: Two-operator FM on one page: ratio, brightness, bite, an envelope pair, noise and a tone sweep. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-hera.description: Roland Juno-60 polysynth: jpcima's Hera engine with its 56 presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-macro-osc.description: Macro Osc: a macro oscillator with 47 synthesis models, from Émilie Gillet's open-source Braids. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-modal-voice.description: Modal Voice: a modal synthesis voice you bow, blow and strike, with 12 presets, from Émilie Gillet's open-source Elements. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-monksynth.description: A formant (FOF) singing voice with 12 characters and a choir. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-monovoice.description: Elektron Monomachine-style digital voice: SuperWave, SID, DigiPRO, FM and more machines; 12 factory patches. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-mrhyde.description: A MicroFreak-inspired voice: Plaits models with a low-pass gate, filter and a 6x6 mod matrix, with 19 presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-noisemaker.description: TAL-NoiseMaker: a classic virtual-analog polysynth with 256 factory presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-nusaw.description: A detuned multi-saw (supersaw) polysynth with 27 presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-obxd.description: Oberheim OB-X: reales' OB-Xd with its 128 factory presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-open303.description: TB-303 bass line: Open303 with the Devilfish mods, a drive stage and 13 presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-raffosynth.description: RaffoSynth: a Minimoog-style mono synth with four oscillators and a ladder filter. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-resonator.description: Resonator: a resonator strummed by the notes you play, with 14 presets, from Émilie Gillet's open-source Rings. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-tablor.description: A two-oscillator wavetable synth that ships with its wavetables and 9 factory presets. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

saustin2010/mpc-vst-wurl.description: A physically modelled Wurlitzer 200A electric piano. A native VST2 plugin with its own touchscreen skin for MPC OS standalone devices.

dreamstaticsounds/sysex-bandit.description: Sysex Bandit is an MPC/Force plugin that can speak sysex with your hardware.

MagicStino/TinyFreaky.description: TinyFreaky by MagicStino — eight-voice synthesizer for Akai Force and MPC via OpenPlugin, Windows/macOS/Linux VST3 and macOS Audio Unit. See OpenPlugin for supported MPC versions.

GreasySavage/TouchEQ-8.description: TouchEQ 8: 8-band touch EQ for standalone Akai MPCs

stampman3000-jpg/mpc-tributary.description: Tributary plays one Elektron Overbridge output per Akai MPC plugin track over USB.

3dthc/Tropix.description: Tropix: island and Afro sounds ROMpler for Akai MPC standalone (ARM VST2)

jacob-sabella/mpc-vst-tuner.description: A chromatic tuner insert for the Akai MPC that draws its needle straight onto the MPC's screen

3dthc/Tuney-MPC.description: Real-time vocal pitch correction for Akai MPC OS standalone devices, as a native VST2 audio effect built with mpc-vst-plugins.

stampman3000-jpg/twenty.description: Ported to MPC by Stampman3000. All synthesis DSP is Audio Tools' AT20V (github.com/palmereta/audio_tools), unchanged; I only did the MPC port.

sunskiefer/VADER.description: Orbit-based vector synth for Akai Force / MPC OS (VST2) — load SVG, 3D or image shapes to drive the sound.

sd88me/mpc-vst-vavra.description: A Waldorf microQ emulation that runs as a plugin instrument on Akai MPC Gen2 standalone devices

anthonytheinventor/vhs-vibes.description: VHS Vibes: a VHS tape degradation effect plugin for Akai MPC standalone hardware (MPC Plugin SDK)

nachtaktiv303/mpc-vst-vibe-fx.description: Vibe FX — a native Akai MPC OS insert effect: drive, chorus, reverb and tape delay in one slot (VST2, MPC skin).

stampman3000-jpg/voxman.description: Voxman — 8/12/16/20-band 4-pole TPT vocoder with lock-free Voxboy carrier sidechain, sibilance clarity, formant shift, internal string/chord carrier, and BBD ensemble chorus.

Luminous-Works/mpc-vst-vulcan-rotary.description: Vulcan Rotary: a six-barrel rotary gate and stutter effect for Akai MPC (Lumina Aerospace)

CLVRK3/warpline-mpc.description: The Vital spectral-warping wavetable synth engine, running as a plugin on MPC standalone, built with the MPC Plugin SDK. It runs Vital's real engine, not a copy of it: the same oscillators, warps, filters, envelopes, LFOs, modulation matrix and effects. It plays .vital patches. Vital's GUI is not included because the MPC has no plugin windows. Inst

sd88me/mpc-vst-welle.description: A Waldorf Wave emulation that runs as a plugin instrument on Akai MPC Gen2 standalone devices built on the emulation by mo0kid: a model of the Wave's voice circuits driven by the instrument's own OS 1.700, running on emulated 68000s.

sunskiefer/Wreck.description: Wreck: a sound design instrument for Akai Force / MPC OS (VST2, ARMv7). It records its own chain of sources and effects into a 20-second loop and plays it back with MIDI voices, feeding its sound back into itself. Made for exploring sounds for hours.

sd88me/mpc-vst-xenia.description: Usual Suspect Xenia emulation of the Waldorf Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer as a native VST2 instrument for Akai MPC Gen2 standalone devices

eldontyrellcorp/mpc-plugin-xp08.description: The repository contains the code for my freely available XP-80 emulator for the MPC

sunskiefer/XXL-Strips.description: Master colour processor: drive, two-band shelving EQ, HF compressor, stereo image, transformer, VU.

keebz/Z950.description: Live Akai S-series style time stretch and pitch shift with an S950 filter, a CD-deck cue/scrub and a looper with adjustable sample rate. Insert effect for Akai MPC.

sunskiefer/EMU.description: Multiple emulation plugins. Bring your own ROMS

Devko/AmbientWerk.description: AmbientWerk is a VST2 instrument for MPC OS's built-in plugin host, with its own touchscreen pages and Q-Link sets, built for slow music that keeps breathing after you stop playing. One gesture drives several layers of sound, the strata, through a shared harmony brain: press one pad and a drone moves under a chord, both in key and in just intonatio

open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins.description: Sunflower Fibonacci Sequencer: two arms step through a Vogel sunflower lattice (3:5 to 34:55 Fibonacci pairs, golden angle) over a Latin/Caribbean percussion bed. Self-sounding, follows the MPC clock. Lumina Aerospace LLC.

Devko/GrooveWerk.description: A VST2 insert effect for MPC OS's built-in plugin host, a sibling of EffectWerk and MasterWerk on the same groundwork. It pumps, shapes, echoes and bends time: a shortcut to a groove that works, not a showpiece. Four parts, Pump, Shape, Echo and Time, and 16 one-tap Moves.

Devko/MasterWerk.description: A VST2 insert effect for MPC OS's built-in plugin host, a sibling of EffectWerk, PolyWerk and SubWerk on the same groundwork. Without setup it never lets the master clip and changes nothing below its ceiling. Press LEARN, play the loudest 8 bars, and it sets a broad tone, a little glue and the gain for a loudness target (YouTube −14 LUFS, Loud −10)

molgino/noxend-mpc-plugins.description: Some plugins for Akai MPC standalone

PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins.description: Free plugins for Akai MPC standalone: PotentialBreaks, PotentialWax, PotentialPatina, PotentialPunch, PotentialHeat, PotentialNoise

sunskiefer/Tone3000MPC.description: TONE3000 NAM A2 amps, pedals and IR cabs with online library browsing, as an effect plugin.

asearan/Wavelight.description: Stereo master tuning insert. Shifts a finished mix from A4 440 Hz to 444 Hz and keeps the tempo.
